explain: '달걀말이'라고도 하며 둘 다 맞는 말이에요. 도시락 반찬이나 식당 밑반찬으로 자주 나와요. 풀어 놓은 달걀을 얇게 부어 돌돌 말아서 만들어요.

phrases.en: I made and ate gyeranmari this morning.
phrases.nuance_ko: '계란말이'와 같은 음식이고 둘 다 맞는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The same dish as 계란말이; both words are correct.

phrases.en: I put in green onions and made gyeranmari.
phrases.nuance_ko: 음식을 직접 만든다는 뜻으로 가장 쉽게 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The simplest way to say you made the dish yourself.

phrases.en: I packed gyeranmari in the picnic lunch box.
phrases.nuance_en: 싸다 is used for packing food into a lunch box.

explain_en: It is also called '달걀말이', and both forms are correct. It often shows up as a side dish in lunchboxes and at restaurants. It is made by pouring thin layers of beaten egg and rolling them up.
